name: first-light
about: The normal-shaded sphere and the sky, at the size and the camera of the Lean original. One ray per pixel, no bounces: what it measures is the ray-sphere test and the colour conversion, not sampling.

name: spheres-preview
about: The four-sphere scene (ground, glass, diffuse, metal) at the browser's default size. The everyday case: a full image, enough samples for clean edges.

name: spheres-quality
about: The same four spheres, smaller but at 64 samples and 50 bounces: the deep-recursion case, where the glass sphere keeps rays alive the longest.

name: weekend-small
about: The book's final scene, 488 spheres, kept small because every ray is tested against every one of them: this is the example that shows what the sphere count costs.
